semiconductor_relevance: High — Boschman specializes in advanced packaging solutions, including die attach and molding technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Suzhou Boschman Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. is a high-tech company providing innovative packaging solutions for the semiconductor industry. They offer a comprehensive range of services from concept to industrialization, focusing on technologies such as silver sintering and film-assisted molding to enhance packaging efficiency and reliability.
capabilities: Silver sintering technology for die attach
Dynamic Insert Technology (DIT) for pressure control
Through Polymer Via (TPV) for high-density interconnections

regional_presence.China: Boschman operates in China, focusing on the local semiconductor packaging market.
